content.title: Documentary Follow | Chance Encounter and Departure
content.summary: Follow the same character laterally out of a narrow starting space while the camera drifts back to reveal a larger route. Allow one chance encounter and one restrained response, then let the character continue the departure.

quick_start.input_format: Continuous lateral follow + narrow starting point + route revealed in motion + one chance encounter + one restrained response + continued departure
quick_start.recommended_input: The night baker walks from the narrow service aisle to the covered ferry terminal, with the camera drifting from the side to behind him; a homing pigeon lands in front of his path, he only nods and takes half a step sideways, then continues past the camera toward the service door.
required_anchors: First follow with a side shot, then reveal the larger route
Characters continue walking during camera transitions
Only one chance encounter occurs throughout the entire film
Respond with restraint and do not stop the course
At the end, characters continue to pass by or move away from the camera
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: The same character is followed from the side as he leaves a narrow space, and the camera floats behind him to reveal a larger route; only one chance encounter and one restrained response occurs, and the character then continues to leave.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Follow one subject through a real public route without stopping the world for coverage. Start in side profile, let the camera drift behind as the space opens, allow one incidental person or event to cross the route, capture a single restrained acknowledgment, then continue past the camera so the encounter remains a lived moment rather than a staged climax.

invariants.rule: Begin with a side-profile follow before revealing the larger route.
invariants.purpose: Creates a spatial discovery rather than an establishing postcard.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting wide removes the observer's gradual reveal.

invariants.rule: Keep the subject walking through the camera transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping for coverage makes the passage feel staged.

invariants.rule: Allow exactly one incidental crossing or encounter to enter the established route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple incidents turn observation into montage.

invariants.rule: Use one restrained acknowledgment without halting the route.
invariants.purpose: Gives the event emotional weight while staying naturalistic.
invariants.ablation_failure: A large reaction becomes a climax the scene has not earned.

invariants.rule: End with continued movement past or away from camera.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the encounter embedded in ordinary life.
invariants.ablation_failure: A posed final look converts the piece into a portrait.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source flower shop and public square
